C0592.title: Guangdong Shantou Teweina Hotel Fabricated Strikethrough Pricing Case
C0592.summary: On February 11, 2026, Shantou market regulators inspected Teweina Hotel on Yingchun Road in Jinping District. They found that the hotel displayed room strikethrough prices from 2,830 to 5,500 yuan on an online platform, while Spring Festival booking prices were 1,414 to 2,183 yuan. Preliminary checks found that the rooms had never traded at those strikethrough prices and all actual prices were lower, so regulators opened a case for suspected fabricated reference pricing.
